messages:
anna-k: RC candidate ready for staging -> prod promotion: v1.9.0-rc3 (sha: a1b2c3d). Window 2026-04-12 10:00-12:00 UTC. Asking for final sign-offs (eng, SRE, product).

mike-r: quick check — any DB migrations or schema toggles in this RC?

jen-pham: release notes posted: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/v1.9.0-rc3 (minor feature: prompt-tokenizer tweak, bugfix: caching race). No schema changes. DB freeze not needed.

sre-oncall-tom: good. I'll want a staged canary: 5% (10m), 25% (20m), then full if healthy. Health checks: 200s, tail-p95 latency under 220ms. Ready to take sheriff.

sam-ml: heads-up — tokenizer tweak changes avg tokenization length by ~+1 token in some cases. Watch the cost dashboard during canary. Recommend pinning quant-profile: q4_8-default for prod.

anna-k: noted, sam. We'll pin quant-profile and artifact. Jen, can you add quant-profile note to relnotes?

jen-pham: done. added: "Production quantization profile: q4_8-default (pinned)."

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] preflight checks: build a1b2c3d verified, unit tests ✅, e2e smoke ✅, canary image pushed to registry. Artifact pinned: redwood-inference:v1.9.0-rc3.

mike-r: thumbs on rollback strategy? If canary fails, we revert routing to v1.9.0-rc2 and revoke pin. Any stateful migrations to handle?

sre-oncall-tom: rollback plan: routing rollback to previous artifact (v1.9.0-rc2). No DB migrations in this RC. If we see error budget > 2% or p95 latency > 350ms for 5m, we trigger rollback. Sheriff to call.

anna-k: operational checklist before lift: 1) Pin artifact and quant profile 2) Deploy canary at 5% 3) Watch health & metrics 4) escalate if thresholds hit. Anyone block?

eli-p: product sign-off from my side, small UX risk acknowledged. :thumbsup:

mike-r: eng sign-off from me.

sam-ml: ok from ML infra after quant pin.

sre-oncall-tom: SRE sign-off. I'll be sheriff for the window.

anna-k: great — executing the pin and kicking deploy now. Command:```deploybot pin redwood-inference:v1.9.0-rc3 --quant=q4_8-default --env=prod --until=2026-05-12```

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] pin applied. Canary rollout initiated: 5% traffic -> redwood-inference:v1.9.0-rc3. Canary timers: 10m. Monitoring links: https://console.redwood/metrics/canary/v1.9.0-rc3

(10m later)

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary 5% health OK. Elevating to 25% per plan.

anna-k: moving to 25%. SRE, keep me posted on p95 and error rate.

sre-oncall-tom: p95 stable ~210ms, error rate 0.4%. continuing.

(30m later)

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary 25% health OK. Promoting to 100% per approved rollout plan.

sre-oncall-tom: final check passed, promoting.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] promotion complete: redwood-inference:v1.9.0-rc3 now receiving 100% prod traffic. Rollback window until 2026-05-12 while pin is active.

anna-k: thanks team — closing the loop. If anything odd, call the rollback playbook.

eli-p: noted, adding post-deploy verification item to PM board.

jen-pham: will send short customer-facing blurb to #announcements in 30m.

mike-r: nice and smooth. :party_parrot:

(END)
